leads.title: Senior Product Manager
leads.snippet: About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there. You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls. AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build.
